senses.en: Some in questions or negatives; whichever one, without restriction.
Some or whichever ones, without naming the people or things.
At all, used mainly with comparisons in questions or negatives.

ex.en: You can borrow any book from this shelf.
ex.zh: 这个书架上的书，你想借哪本都可以。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all children can attend school without facing any financial barriers.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有儿童都能上学，不受任何经济障碍的阻碍。

col: any of these｜这些中的任何一个
tip: 疑问、否定句中常表“一些”；肯定句中常表“任何”。

senses.en: a situation that causes difficulty and needs a solution
a question requiring thought or calculation to answer

ex.en: There's a problem with the kitchen tap: it keeps dripping.
ex.zh: 厨房的水龙头有问题：它一直滴水。

ex.en: Traffic congestion is a growing problem that requires investment in reliable public transport rather than additional roads.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵是日益严重的问题，需要投资建设可靠的公共交通，而不是增建道路。

tip: ……有问题用a problem with；问题的解决办法用to。

senses.en: To desire something or wish for something to happen.
A lack of something needed, especially basic necessities.

ex.en: I want to grow tomatoes on our balcony.
ex.zh: 我想在我们的阳台上种番茄。

ex.en: Many young adults want governments to invest more in affordable housing rather than expensive urban redevelopment projects.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人希望政府更多投资于可负担住房，而不是昂贵的城市重建项目。

col: want to do something｜想做某事
want someone to do something｜想让某人做某事
tip: 用want to do或want sb to do，不用want doing表想做。

senses.en: To make something go or be delivered to another place.
To arrange for someone to go somewhere.

ex.en: Please send me a photo of your new puppy.
ex.zh: 请发一张你家新养的小狗的照片给我。

ex.en: Governments should send medical teams to isolated communities that lack access to basic healthcare.
ex.zh: 政府应向缺乏基本医疗服务的偏远社区派遣医疗队。

col: send someone to do something｜派某人去做某事
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sent；可用send sth to sb。

senses.zh: 电子邮件；电子邮件通信
senses.en: An electronic message, or the system used to send it
Send someone a message using email

ex.en: Please email me the photos from our camping trip.
ex.zh: 请把我们露营旅行的照片通过电子邮件发给我。

ex.en: Although email enables rapid communication, excessive messages can distract employees and reduce productivity at work.
ex.zh: 虽然电子邮件可以实现快速沟通，但过多的邮件会分散员工注意力，降低工作效率。

col: send an email｜发送电子邮件
check your email｜查看电子邮件
an email address｜电子邮箱地址
tip: 指一封邮件时可数；指通信方式时不可数，如by email。

senses.zh: 在（表示存在或出现的地点、场所、位置、空间）；以（某种价格、速度等）；向；达；因为；朝；忙于
senses.en: used to say what event or activity someone is taking part in

senses.zh: 阿特（老挝货币基本单位att）；砹（极不稳定放射性元素）

ex.en: I met my wife at a disco.
ex.zh: 我在迪斯科舞会上认识了我的妻子。

ex.en: The matter was discussed at a meeting of the finance committee.
ex.zh: 这件事在财务委员会的会议上讨论过了。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: a living thing that usually grows in soil and has leaves
to put seeds or young plants into soil to grow
a factory or facility where industrial processes take place

ex.en: This little plant needs more sunlight and less water.
ex.zh: 这株小植物需要更多阳光和更少的水。

ex.en: Local authorities should plant more trees to improve air quality and provide shade in crowded neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 地方政府应多种树，以改善空气质量，并为人口密集的社区提供绿荫。

tip: plant可指植物或工厂；作动词时常表示种植。

senses.en: A narrow-necked container for liquids, or the amount it holds.
To put a liquid into bottles for storage or sale.

ex.en: She filled her water bottle before leaving the house.
ex.zh: 她出门前把水瓶装满了。

ex.en: Choosing a reusable bottle instead of disposable plastic containers can help reduce waste in cities.
ex.zh: 选择可重复使用的瓶子而非一次性塑料容器，有助于减少城市垃圾。

col: reusable bottle｜可重复使用的瓶子
tip: a bottle of water是一瓶水；water bottle是水瓶。

senses.en: a bicycle or, informally, a motorcycle
to travel somewhere by bicycle

ex.en: I locked my bike outside the corner shop.
ex.zh: 我把自行车锁在街角商店外面。

ex.en: Encouraging commuters to travel by bike could reduce urban congestion and improve public health.
ex.zh: 鼓励通勤者骑自行车出行可以缓解城市拥堵，并改善公众健康。

tip: by bike不加冠词；ride a bike中的a不能省。

senses.en: A picture made using a camera.

ex.en: We took a photo beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们在那座老桥旁拍了张照片。

ex.en: Historical photos provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.
ex.zh: 历史照片为研究城市景观和日常生活方式如何随时间变化提供了宝贵证据。

tip: photo是photograph的常用简称；复数为photos。

senses.en: The forward part or outward-facing surface of something.
Located at or near the forward part of something.
A boundary where masses of warm and cold air meet.

ex.en: Please leave your muddy boots by the front door.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在前门旁。

ex.en: Placing bicycle racks at the front of public buildings can encourage more residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑前部设置自行车架，可以鼓励更多居民骑车出行。

col: at the front of｜在……的前部
tip: in front of指外部前方；at the front of指前部。

senses.en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events.

senses.zh: 涉及双方或多方；由…共享
senses.en: Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them.
In the space or interval separating things.

ex.en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
ex.zh: 猫从沙发和墙之间挤了过去。

ex.en: Cooperation between schools and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering employment.
ex.zh: 学校与当地企业的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。

col: between them｜由他们共同；在他们之间
tip: between不只限于两者，也可用于多个明确对象之间。

senses.en: In a higher position than something else.
Greater than a particular amount, level, or standard.
In a higher place or earlier in a piece of writing.

ex.en: A small wooden shelf hangs above the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 厨房水槽上方挂着一个小木架。

ex.en: Temperatures above the seasonal average can increase water demand and put pressure on urban supplies.
ex.zh: 高于当季平均水平的气温会增加用水需求，给城市供水带来压力。

tip: above 表示位置更高，不一定正上方，也不表示接触。

senses.en: At the side of someone or something.

ex.en: Please leave your wet boots beside the door.
ex.zh: 请把你的湿靴子放在门旁边。

ex.en: Creating walking paths beside urban rivers can encourage physical activity and improve residents' access to nature.
ex.zh: 在城市河流旁修建步道可以鼓励身体活动，并让居民更容易亲近自然。

col: sit beside someone｜坐在某人旁边
tip: beside表示“在旁边”；besides表示“此外；除……之外”。

senses.en: at or towards the back of someone or something
at the back or making less progress than expected
responsible for causing or supporting something

ex.en: Your umbrella is behind the door in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 你的伞在厨房的门后面。

ex.en: Students who fall behind at school may benefit from additional support rather than stricter discipline.
ex.zh: 在学校学习落后的学生可能更需要额外的支持，而非更严格的纪律。

tip: behind可作介词或副词；fall behind表示落后。

senses.en: In, at, or towards that place.
Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

senses.zh: 祖父母或外祖父母之一
senses.en: The father or mother of one of your parents.

ex.en: Each grandparent brought a homemade dish to our picnic.
ex.zh: 每位祖辈都带了一道自制的菜来参加我们的野餐。

ex.en: A grandparent can provide valuable emotional support when both parents work outside the home.
ex.zh: 当父母都在外工作时，祖父母或外祖父母可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: visit your grandparents｜探望祖父母或外祖父母
tip: 单数指一位祖辈；复数可指祖父母或外祖父母。

senses.en: used when talking about someone who may be male or female, to avoid saying ‘his or her’

ex.en: They talked her round to their position.
ex.zh: 他们说服她同意他们的看法。

senses.en: A building where a person or family lives.
To provide a place for people or things to stay.

ex.en: Their house has a small garden behind the kitchen.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在厨房后面有一个小花园。

ex.en: Local authorities could convert unused office buildings into apartments to house families in need of affordable accommodation.
ex.zh: 地方政府可以将闲置办公楼改造成公寓，为需要可负担住房的家庭提供住所。

tip: 名词读/haʊs/，动词读/haʊz/；home更强调家的归属感。

senses.en: a large amount or number, in a lot or lots
very much or often, in the phrase a lot
an area of land used for a particular purpose

ex.en: We bought a lot of fresh fruit today.
ex.zh: 我们今天买了很多新鲜水果。

ex.en: Cities can save a lot of energy by improving public transport and encouraging residents to walk.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通并鼓励居民步行来节约大量能源。

col: a lot of time｜大量时间
tip: a lot of接可数复数或不可数名词；a lot可修饰动词。

senses.en: The often colourful part of a plant that produces seeds.
To produce flowers.

ex.en: She placed fresh flowers in a vase by the window.
ex.zh: 她把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。

ex.en: Planting native flowers in urban parks can support pollinating insects and improve local biodiversity.
ex.zh: 在城市公园种植本地花卉能够帮助传粉昆虫生存，并改善当地生物多样性。

tip: flower既可作名词“花”，也可作动词“开花”。

senses.en: To change position or go to live somewhere else.
To make someone feel a strong emotion.
An action taken to achieve a particular result.

ex.en: Could you move this chair closer to the window?
ex.zh: 你能把这把椅子挪到靠窗一点的位置吗？

ex.en: The decision to expand public transport is a positive move towards reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 扩大公共交通的决定是缓解城市拥堵的一项积极举措。

col: move forward｜向前移动；取得进展
tip: moving指令人感动的，moved指感到感动的。

senses.en: Covered with dirt or other unwanted substances.
Dishonest or unfair, especially when trying to gain an advantage.
To make something dirty or become dirty.

ex.en: Please leave your dirty boots outside the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 请把你的脏靴子放在厨房门外。

ex.en: Limited access to clean water forces many communities to rely on dirty sources that can spread disease.
ex.zh: 清洁水源不足迫使许多社区依赖可能传播疾病的污浊水源。

tip: 比较级dirtier，最高级dirtiest。

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

tip: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

senses.en: A small rodent with a pointed nose and long thin tail.
A handheld device for moving a pointer on a computer screen.

ex.en: A tiny mouse slipped behind the cupboard before breakfast.
ex.zh: 早饭前，一只小老鼠溜到了橱柜后面。

ex.en: Using a mouse for long periods may cause wrist discomfort, so office workers should take regular breaks.
ex.zh: 长时间使用鼠标可能引起手腕不适，因此办公室职员应定时休息。

tip: 老鼠的复数是mice；鼠标的复数可用mice或mouses。

senses.en: to have your home somewhere, lead a life, or remain alive
broadcast or performed as it happens, rather than recorded
alive rather than dead

ex.en: My grandparents live in a quiet village near the coast.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母住在海边一个安静的村庄里。

ex.en: People who live near public transport often depend less on private cars for their daily journeys.
ex.zh: 住在公共交通设施附近的人日常出行往往较少依赖私家车。

col: live a healthy life｜过健康的生活
tip: 动词读/lɪv/；形容词及表示现场直播的副词读/laɪv/。

senses.en: The physical world, including plants, animals, and landscapes.
The basic qualities that make something what it is.
The qualities that shape how a person usually behaves.

ex.en: Camping helps us enjoy nature away from busy streets.
ex.zh: 露营让我们远离繁忙的街道，享受大自然。

ex.en: Understanding the nature of urban poverty is essential for developing policies that address its underlying causes.
ex.zh: 了解城市贫困的本质，对制定解决其根本原因的政策至关重要。

tip: 指大自然时通常不加the；某事的性质用the nature of。

senses.en: a large area of land covered mainly with trees

ex.en: We followed a narrow path deep into the forest.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条狭窄的小路走进森林深处。

ex.en: Protecting natural forests helps preserve biodiversity and reduces the amount of carbon dioxide in the atmosphere.
ex.zh: 保护天然森林有助于维护生物多样性，并减少大气中的二氧化碳含量。

tip: forest通常指大片森林；wood也可指较小树林。

senses.en: a large natural stream of water flowing towards another water body

ex.en: We watched ducks swimming across the river this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我们看着鸭子游过河面。

ex.en: Protecting river ecosystems requires cooperation between farming communities, local industries, and environmental agencies.
ex.zh: 保护河流生态系统需要农业社区、当地企业和环境机构之间的合作。

tip: 河名通常带the，如the River Nile。

senses.en: A large area of water surrounded by land.

ex.en: We rented a small boat and crossed the lake.
ex.zh: 我们租了一条小船，划到了湖对岸。

ex.en: Agricultural pollution can damage lake ecosystems and threaten the communities that rely on them for drinking water.
ex.zh: 农业污染会破坏湖泊生态系统，并威胁依靠湖水获取饮用水的社区。

col: the shore of a lake｜湖岸
tip: on the lake 指在湖面上；in the lake 指在湖水中。

senses.en: a very high area of land with steep sides
a very large amount of something

ex.en: Snow covered the mountain even in the middle of summer.
ex.zh: 即使在盛夏，那座山仍被白雪覆盖。

ex.en: Mountain communities often face higher transport costs because steep terrain makes road construction more difficult.
ex.zh: 山区社区往往面临更高的运输成本，因为陡峭的地形增加了修路的难度。

col: a mountain of work｜堆积如山的工作
tip: 一座山用 mountain；山脉通常用 mountain range。

senses.en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
ex.zh: 我们爬上小山，看了日落。

ex.en: Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.
ex.zh: 在陡峭的山坡上建房会增加建设成本，并使居民面临滑坡风险。

tip: hill通常比mountain低矮，但没有统一高度界限。

senses.en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

ex.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

senses.en: A structure carrying people or vehicles over an obstacle.
To connect separated things or reduce differences between them.
A card game played by four people in two partnerships.

ex.en: We crossed the wooden bridge and entered the village.
ex.zh: 我们走过木桥，进了村子。

ex.en: Community language programmes can bridge cultural differences and help newcomers participate more fully in local life.
ex.zh: 社区语言项目可以弥合文化差异，帮助新来者更充分地参与当地生活。

tip: bridge the gap常指缩小群体或事物间的差距。

senses.en: a structure with walls and a roof
the activity of constructing houses or other structures

ex.en: Our apartment building has a garden on the roof.
ex.zh: 我们住的公寓楼屋顶上有一个花园。

ex.en: Improving insulation in older buildings can reduce energy consumption and lower heating costs for residents.
ex.zh: 改善老旧建筑的隔热性能可以减少能源消耗，降低居民的取暖费用。

tip: 指建筑物时可数，指建造活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: A small community of homes, usually in the countryside.
The people who live in a village, considered together.

ex.en: Our village has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们村的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Reliable public transport can help village residents access employment, education, and healthcare in nearby towns.
ex.zh: 可靠的公共交通可以帮助村民前往附近城镇就业、求学和就医。

tip: the whole village可指全村居民，而非建筑。

senses.en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
ex.zh: 一只白兔蹦蹦跳跳地穿过草地，朝我们跑来。

ex.en: Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 将兔子引入新环境可能破坏原生植被，扰乱当地生态系统的平衡。

tip: rabbit泛指兔；hare通常指腿耳更长的野兔。

senses.en: extending far upwards or positioned far above the ground
greater than usual in amount, degree, or quality
at or to a position far above the ground

ex.en: The shelf is too high for me to reach.
ex.zh: 架子太高了，我够不着。

ex.en: High housing costs can prevent young adults from living independently, particularly in major urban centres.
ex.zh: 高昂的住房成本可能使年轻人无法独立居住，在大城市中心尤其如此。

tip: high常指位置或程度；人的身高用tall。

senses.en: Physical activity for health, or a task for practising skills.
To do physical activity to stay healthy or become stronger.
To use a right, power, ability, or quality.

ex.en: I get some exercise by walking to the shops.
ex.zh: 我步行去商店，顺便锻炼一下。

ex.en: Regular exercise can improve mental health and reduce the risk of several common chronic diseases.
ex.zh: 经常运动能够改善心理健康，并降低几种常见慢性病的患病风险。

tip: 泛指运动时不可数；一项练习或一套动作中的动作可数。

senses.en: To pick up, hold, or carry something away.
To require a particular amount of time or effort.
To use a particular form of transport.

ex.en: Take an umbrella because it might rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 带把伞吧，今天下午可能会下雨。

ex.en: Developing reliable public transport networks takes considerable time and requires sustained investment from local authorities.
ex.zh: 建设可靠的公共交通网络需要相当长的时间，也需要地方政府持续投入资金。

tip: 过去式took，过去分词taken；take带走，bring带来。

senses.en: the activity of moving your body rhythmically, usually to music

ex.en: We go dancing together at the community centre every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我们每周六都一起去社区中心跳舞。

ex.en: Regular dancing can improve physical fitness while providing opportunities for social interaction across different age groups.
ex.zh: 经常跳舞可以改善体能，同时为不同年龄群体提供社交机会。

tip: 作活动名词通常不可数；去跳舞用go dancing。

senses.en: At what time.
At the time that something happens.
Considering that something is true.

ex.en: When does the next bus leave for town?
ex.zh: 下一班去镇上的公交车什么时候发车？

ex.en: When cities invest in reliable public transport, residents are more likely to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 当城市投资建设可靠的公共交通时，居民就更可能不开私家车出行。

tip: 表将来的时间从句中，when后通常用一般现在时。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

senses.en: To begin doing something or cause something to begin.
To make a machine operate, or begin operating.
The moment or place where something begins.

ex.en: We started cooking dinner as soon as we got home.
ex.zh: 我们一到家就开始做晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should start teaching financial skills early so that young people can make informed decisions about money.
ex.zh: 学校应尽早开始教授理财技能，让年轻人能在充分了解情况后作出财务决定。

col: at the start of｜在……开始时
make a fresh start｜重新开始
tip: start doing与start to do通常都可表示开始做某事。

senses.en: On most occasions, but not always.

ex.en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
ex.zh: 除非下雨，我通常步行上班。

ex.en: People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.
ex.zh: 有朋友和家人的支持，人们通常更容易保持健康的习惯。

col: as usually happens｜正如通常发生的那样
tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: a country in southwestern Europe

ex.en: We travelled around Spain by train last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，我们乘火车游览了西班牙。

ex.en: Spain attracts international visitors through its cultural heritage, varied landscapes, and well-developed tourism infrastructure.
ex.zh: 西班牙凭借文化遗产、多样的景观和完善的旅游基础设施吸引国际游客。

col: travel to Spain｜前往西班牙旅行
tip: 国名首字母大写，前面通常不加the。

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
after the expected time or towards a period's end
used before mentioning a person who has died

ex.en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。

ex.en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
ex.zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。

tip: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

senses.en: During the time from midnight until just before midday.

ex.en: My alarm rings at seven a.m. every weekday.
ex.zh: 每个工作日，我的闹钟都在早上七点响。

ex.en: Starting school before eight a.m. may reduce the amount of sleep that teenagers get on weekdays.
ex.zh: 早上八点前上课可能会减少青少年在上学期间的睡眠时间。

col: from nine a.m.｜从上午九点起
until eleven a.m.｜直到上午十一点
tip: 放在钟点后；12 a.m.是午夜，12 p.m.是正午。

senses.en: after noon and before midnight, used when stating a time

ex.en: The swimming pool closes at eight p.m. today.
ex.zh: 游泳池今天晚上八点关门。

ex.en: Keeping public libraries open until nine p.m. would allow more working adults to access educational resources.
ex.zh: 让公共图书馆开放至晚上九点，可以使更多在职成年人获取教育资源。

col: until ten p.m.｜直到晚上十点
tip: 放在时间后；12 p.m.是中午，12 a.m.是午夜。

senses.en: used to ask about the reason for something
introduces the reason for a situation or action

ex.en: Why are your shoes still wet this morning?
ex.zh: 为什么你的鞋今天早上还是湿的？

ex.en: Researchers need to understand why some students leave education before completing their secondary school qualifications.
ex.zh: 研究人员需要了解，为什么有些学生尚未取得中学学历就离开了学校。

tip: 间接疑问句用陈述语序：I know why he left。

senses.en: A place where people buy goods or services.
To visit stores or websites to look for and buy things.

ex.en: The little shop near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的小店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Independent shops can strengthen local economies by creating jobs and keeping spending within the community.
ex.zh: 独立商店可以通过创造就业并让消费留在社区内，促进地方经济。

tip: 买某类商品用shop for；泛指去购物用go shopping。

senses.zh: 工作； 功；产品；操作；职业；行为；事业；工厂；著作；文学、音乐或艺术作品
senses.en: a job or activity that you do regularly, especially in order to earn money

senses.zh: 使工作；操作；经营；使缓慢前进
senses.en: to do the activities and duties that are part of your job

ex.en: There isn’t a lot of work at this time of the year.
ex.zh: 每年这个时候工作机会都不多。

ex.en: He’s been out of work (without a job ) for two years.
ex.zh: 他失业有两年了。

senses.en: Final in a sequence, or most recent before the present.
To continue for a period or remain usable.
After everyone else, or on the most recent previous occasion.

ex.en: I caught the last bus home just before midnight.
ex.zh: 我在午夜前刚好赶上了回家的末班车。

ex.en: Products that last longer can reduce household spending and limit the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 更耐用的产品可以减少家庭开支，并减少送往垃圾填埋场的废物量。

tip: last week指上周；the last week可指最后一周。

senses.en: something you hear
to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise
sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
ex.zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
ex.zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

tip: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

senses.en: in addition to something already mentioned

ex.en: My sister plays tennis and also enjoys swimming.
ex.zh: 我姐姐打网球，也喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Public libraries provide free books, but they also offer valuable spaces for community learning.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆提供免费书籍，也为社区学习提供宝贵的空间。

col: not only ... but also｜不仅……而且
tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；不是连词。

senses.en: Having many things to do or being actively occupied.
Full of people, traffic, or activity.
Already being used, especially a telephone line.

ex.en: I am busy making soup for dinner right now.
ex.zh: 我现在正忙着做晚餐要喝的汤。

ex.en: Busy urban roads can discourage cycling unless local authorities provide safe routes separated from motor traffic.
ex.zh: 繁忙的城市道路可能让人不愿骑车，除非地方政府提供与机动车流隔离的安全路线。

tip: 用busy doing或busy with，不用busy to do。

senses.en: To require something because it is necessary or important
Something necessary or the condition of requiring it
A situation in which essential things are lacking

ex.en: These plants need more water during hot weather.
ex.zh: 天气炎热时，这些植物需要更多的水。

ex.en: Cities need to improve public transport if they want to reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市若想减少人们对私家车的依赖，就需要改善公共交通。

col: need to do something｜需要做某事
meet basic needs｜满足基本需求
tip: need to do表需要做；need doing表需要被做。

senses.en: a written message sent to a person or organisation
a written symbol representing a sound in an alphabet

ex.en: A letter from my sister arrived this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，我收到了姐姐寄来的信。

ex.en: Writing a formal letter of complaint can encourage companies to address problems with their services.
ex.zh: 撰写正式投诉信可以促使企业处理其服务中存在的问题。

tip: letter既指信，也指字母；character还可指汉字等字符。

senses.en: An area of land completely surrounded by water.

ex.en: We took a small boat to the island yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们乘小船去了那座岛。

ex.en: Small island communities often depend on tourism, but increasing visitor numbers can threaten fragile coastal environments.
ex.zh: 小岛上的社区往往依赖旅游业，但游客数量的增加可能威胁脆弱的海岸环境。

tip: s不发音；在岛上用on an island。

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: A large natural hollow inside rock or under the ground.

ex.en: We sheltered from the rain inside a small cave.
ex.zh: 我们躲进一个小山洞里避雨。

ex.en: Ancient paintings found in a cave can reveal how early communities understood their surroundings.
ex.zh: 洞穴中发现的古代绘画可以揭示早期群体如何理解周围环境。

tip: cave指洞穴；动词短语cave in表示坍塌或屈服。

senses.en: To succeed in a competition or receive a prize.
To gain something through effort or personal qualities.
A successful result in a competition or contest.

ex.en: Our team won the match despite the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 尽管下着大雨，我们队还是赢得了比赛。

ex.en: To win public support, governments must explain how environmental policies will benefit communities in the long term.
ex.zh: 为了赢得公众支持，政府必须解释环境政策将如何让社区长期受益。

col: win someone's trust｜赢得某人的信任
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为won；赢比赛用win，击败人用beat。

senses.en: the season between winter and summer
a coiled piece of metal that stretches or compresses
a place where water flows naturally out of the ground

ex.en: We plant flowers in the garden every spring.
ex.zh: 我们每年春天都在花园里种花。

ex.en: Warmer temperatures in spring can cause plants to flower earlier, affecting insects that depend on them.
ex.zh: 春季气温升高会使植物提前开花，影响依赖这些植物的昆虫。

tip: 季节前通常用in；泉和弹簧义均为可数名词。

senses.en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.

ex.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
ex.zh: 夏天傍晚很长，我们常在户外吃饭。

ex.en: Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.
ex.zh: 夏季气温上升可能使更多家庭依赖空调，从而增加电力需求。

tip: 泛指夏季可用in summer；季节名称通常小写。

senses.en: The season between summer and winter

ex.en: We collect fallen leaves in the park every autumn.
ex.zh: 我们每年秋天都在公园里收集落叶。

ex.en: Warmer autumn temperatures may delay leaf fall and affect the seasonal behaviour of local wildlife.
ex.zh: 秋季气温升高可能推迟落叶，并影响当地野生动物的季节性行为。

tip: 字母n不发音；美式英语常用fall表示秋天。

senses.en: The coldest season, between autumn and spring.
To spend the winter in a particular place.

ex.en: We wear thick coats when winter brings cold winds.
ex.zh: 冬天寒风来袭时，我们会穿上厚外套。

ex.en: Warmer winters can disrupt natural ecosystems by changing the seasonal behaviour of plants and migrating animals.
ex.zh: 更暖的冬季可能改变植物和迁徙动物的季节性行为，从而扰乱自然生态系统。

tip: 泛指在冬天用in winter；具体某年可用in the winter of…。

senses.en: One of the main yearly periods with particular weather conditions.
A period when a particular activity or event usually happens.
Add salt, herbs, or spices to improve food's flavour.

ex.en: Autumn is my favourite season for walking in the woods.
ex.zh: 秋天是我最喜欢去林中散步的季节。

ex.en: A longer tourist season can create more stable employment, although it may increase pressure on local resources.
ex.zh: 更长的旅游旺季可以创造更稳定的就业，但也可能加大当地资源的压力。

tip: season作动词指调味，常用season food with…。

senses.en: a meal eaten outdoors, usually with food brought from home
to eat a meal outdoors for pleasure

ex.en: We had a picnic under a shady tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵树的荫凉下野餐。

ex.en: Public parks provide affordable spaces where families can enjoy picnics and spend quality time together.
ex.zh: 公共公园提供了花费不高的空间，让家庭享受野餐并共度美好时光。

tip: 动词过去式为picnicked，进行形式为picnicking。

senses.en: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。

senses.en: Used before a noun to ask about a limited choice.
Used to ask about a choice without repeating the noun.
Introduces information about a thing or a previous statement.

ex.en: Which jacket should I wear to dinner tonight?
ex.zh: 今晚去吃饭我该穿哪件夹克？

ex.en: Governments must decide which policies will improve air quality without placing excessive financial pressure on households.
ex.zh: 政府必须决定哪些政策能改善空气质量，又不会给家庭造成过大的经济压力。

col: in which case｜如果是那样的话
tip: which常用于限定范围内的选择；what范围更开放。

senses.en: Better than all others in quality or suitability.
In the most successful way or to the greatest degree.
The finest performance, effort, or thing available.

ex.en: This bakery makes the best bread in our neighbourhood.
ex.zh: 这家面包店做的面包是我们街区最好的。

ex.en: Investing in early education may be the best way to reduce inequality over time.
ex.zh: 投资早期教育可能是逐步减少不平等的最佳方式。

col: at its best｜处于最佳状态
tip: best是good和well的最高级；形容词前通常加the。

senses.en: Soft white frozen flakes falling from clouds or covering the ground.
For snow to fall from the sky.

ex.en: Fresh snow covered the garden when we woke up.
ex.zh: 我们醒来时，新下的雪覆盖了花园。

ex.en: Heavy snow can disrupt public transport and prevent rural communities from accessing essential services.
ex.zh: 大雪可能扰乱公共交通，使农村社区无法获得基本服务。

tip: snow作名词通常不可数；下雪用it snows。

senses.en: Introduces the reason why something happens or is true.

ex.en: I closed the window because the room felt cold.
ex.zh: 我关上了窗户，因为房间里有点冷。

ex.en: Many commuters choose public transport because it is cheaper and produces fewer emissions than driving alone.
ex.zh: 许多通勤者选择公共交通，因为它比独自开车更省钱，排放也更少。

col: because of the weather｜由于天气原因
tip: because 后接从句；because of 后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: time away from work or study for rest or travel
to spend a holiday somewhere away from home

ex.en: We spent our summer vacation camping beside a lake.
ex.zh: 我们暑假在湖边露营。

ex.en: Taking a regular vacation may improve employees' mental health and help them return to work with greater motivation.
ex.zh: 定期休假可能改善员工的心理健康，并让他们回到工作岗位时更有动力。

tip: 主要用于美式英语；英式英语一般用holiday。

senses.en: the whole amount of something or every member of a group
everything or everyone in a particular group
completely or entirely

ex.en: All the children brought fruit for the picnic.
ex.zh: 所有孩子都带了水果来野餐。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that all citizens have access to affordable healthcare, regardless of their income.
ex.zh: 政府应确保所有公民无论收入如何，都能获得负担得起的医疗服务。

tip: all可接复数或不可数名词；every接单数可数名词。

senses.en: having a pale red colour
a colour made by mixing red with white

ex.en: The tree outside our window has pink flowers.
ex.zh: 我们窗外的树开着粉红色的花。

ex.en: Designers often use soft colours such as pink to create a welcoming atmosphere in children's healthcare facilities.
ex.zh: 设计师常用粉红色等柔和色彩，为儿童医疗机构营造温馨的氛围。

tip: pink既可作形容词，也可作名词表示粉红色。

senses.en: beautiful or attractive in a pleasing way
very pleasant, enjoyable, or kind

ex.en: There are lovely yellow flowers beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房窗边有一些漂亮的黄色花朵。

ex.en: Preserving lovely coastal landscapes can attract visitors while giving local residents valuable spaces for outdoor recreation.
ex.zh: 保护美丽的海岸景观既能吸引游客，也能为当地居民提供宝贵的户外休闲空间。

col: have a lovely time｜玩得愉快
a lovely person｜友善可亲的人
tip: 虽以-ly结尾，却是形容词；英式口语中很常见。
